verdict.summary: The release gui-bundle matrix installs exactly pinned wasm-pack 0.15.0 through a SHA-pinned, architecture-aware prebuilt installer. The guardrail remains job-scoped, ignores comments, verifies an ARM runner and unified exact versions, and its mutation cases meaningfully detect both prohibited regressions. The focused 17-test suite passes. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue was found.
